author: Minestar78
body: I heard that people got permanently banned from avicus network but they told me that they were unbanned like 2 months later. How does permanent ban work in avicus network
body_tagged: I heard that people got permanently banned from avicus network but they told me that they were unbanned like 2 months later. How does permanent ban work in avicus network
title: How Long is a permanent ban in avicus

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
For the most part, we'll appeal pernament bans 6-8 months after the date of the ban depending on the severity of the ban, and the behaviour of the banned player. If the ban player ban evades, he won't be appealed that soon.

If the ban turns out to be invalid, we'll appeal the ban. This could be how the people you've talked to were appealed after 2 months.

And then there's always those few bans that don't go by these rules, where the player can be unbanned as soon as the issue is resolved - like inappropriate name bans.

(But you have to create an appeal to have the ban appealed, otherwise the ban stays permanent forever)
